name: verify_handoff_files
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess,sys
p=Path.cwd(); w=p/'write_lane.py'
f=json.loads(Path('missing-runner-failure.json').read_text())
f['exact_shell_command']="timeout 140 python3 -I -B "+str(p/'researchrun.py')+" inspect_lane <<'PY'\nfrom pathlib import Path\np=Path.cwd()\nfor x in sorted(p.iterdir()):\n print(x.name, x.stat().st_size)\nfor n in ['researchrun.py','write_artifact.py','latest-root-routing.txt']:\n f=p/n\n if f.exists(): print('\\nFILE',n,'\\n',f.read_text())\nPY"
z=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(w),'missing-runner-failure.json'],input=json.dumps(f,indent=2),text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=10);assert z.returncode==0
assert json.loads(Path('family-inventory.json').read_text())['count']==94
assert set(json.loads(Path('review.json').read_text()))=={'332935'}
assert hashlib.sha256(Path('inputs/sources/square.pdf').read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='2bcc115c4a05b01871e5108a6d5b0d49a4cce67f80ee4716dd740d6a6c96d425'
for n in ['REVIEW.md','review.json','family-inventory.json','access-read-inventory.json','missing-runner-failure.json']:print(n,Path(n).stat().st_size,hashlib.sha256(Path(n).read_bytes()).hexdigest())
print('All completed runner receipt statuses:',[(x.name,json.loads(x.read_text()).get('exit')) for x in sorted(p.glob('*.receipt.json'))])
